newsitem.title: USA: "Born again" U.S. child pornographer gets 20 years.
newsitem.headline: "Born again" U.S. child pornographer gets 20 years.

text.p: An Arkansas man who called himself a "born-again Christian" was sentenced to 20 years in prison after he said the adolescent girls he used as pornographic models were "earth angels" he hoped to see again.
John E. Herndon was arrested last year after police raided his Little Rock home and found dozens of snapshots of two girls, aged 14 and 15, in sexually explicit poses.

"They were my muffins and my flowers," Herndon told the judge in a statement read at his sentencing on Monday. "They were earth angels. I renew my promises to the girls as a born-again Christian that I will always love them and protect them. I hope the girls will call me so we will begin anew."
The judge responded by rejecting defence pleas for a reduced sentence and imposed the maximum, 20-year sentence against Herndon, who is a paraplegic from a 1983 motorcycle accident.
Prosecutors said Herndon took the photos after supplying the girls with alcoholic drinks.
Deputy prosecution attorney Tammy Harrelson said on Tuesday that Herndon's remarks in court were "amazing".
"He doesn't understand that what he did was wrong," Harrelson told Reuters. "He either doesn't get it or doesn't care."
